$comment: Sourced French and Italian feast names from the Liturgical Calendar project, Apache-2.0. English source identities and localized titles are joined exclusively by stable LitCal event_key within the same source publication, never by coincident date. Only grade >= 2 events are included; anticipated vigil entries are excluded. Runtime generation matches exact English titles and preserves every calendar's date, rank, original observance, and other language maps. No generated translation or unverified cross-rite equivalence is included. Arabic, Russian, and Filipino sources were checked on 2026-09-05; the official API reported missing lectionary language files, so those languages are omitted. Explicit reviewedEnglishAliases cover abbreviated names of the same saints and feast titles in other bundled calendars; no global Saint/St. normalization or date matching is performed at runtime.
